body:
Worker rule (Termal::Opus3, from Opus2 #1578, 2026-11-18). Before sending READY for any candidate, run `cargo check --bin termal --tests` in my own root. Opus2's request is the GO for that check.

Why: on 2026-11-18, two 2C14 candidates failed to compile only on the remote leg, which would have wasted a review pair. Until a candidate compiles, Opus2 places the exact Linux leg FIRST and the review pair only after the leg passes.

Keep within the Central Cargo budget rules: one check, foreground, in the candidate's own worktree.
